features: Glossy outlook: Zeb-Juke Bar 1610 is a compact soundbar with a glossy finish that can add visual beauty to your home.
Powerful drivers: For exceptional audio quality, this sound bar is equipped with dynamic dual 5.71 cm powerful drivers.
Powerful output: Stream audio from the soundbar with the quality sound produced of 42W high power output.
Playtime and charging: Enjoy uninterrupted audio from the soundbar that has a built-in rechargeable battery delivering up to 7* hours (*at 50% volume ) which is equipped with type-C charging.

Connectivity: This soundbar enables connectivity with various devices through wireless BTv5.0. You can enhance your audio experience with lag-free movies through the wired connection of the TV or smartphone to the soundbar through an AUX(for music streaming) cable and by inserting an mSD memory.
Media/volume control - The soundbar has media and volume control for audio and video control.
LED indicator: The soundbar has LED indicators to identify the speaker's mode and a side panel to indicate charging.
